page.content:
Tarkatan clone sister Shang Tsung made for Shao Kahn.

How Mileena connects

  • Location: Outworld — Mileena is the Tarkatan heir Shang Tsung made for Outworld.
  • Character: Kitana — Mileena was cloned to replace Kitana as a loyal sister-heir.

What is Mileena?

Mileena is Kitana's clone — Tarkatan teeth, sai, and a claim on Outworld's throne — created by Shang Tsung as a more loyal imperial heir.

Key threads lead to Outworld and Kitana.
